C0646.title: Programmer Sentenced to 10 Months for Deleting Code After Resignation, JD Daojia Spent 30,000 Yuan on Database Recovery
C0646.summary: On June 18, 2021, a programmer at JD Daojia logged into the code control platform without authorization on his last day of work and deleted the code for the platform's coupons, budget system, and subsidy rules he had written, causing project delays.
